name: Strigoi
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #215: To Blot Out the Sun, Vampire, Strigoi (pg. 84), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=564
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Adventure Path #215: To Blot Out the Sun is ORC licensed material.
rules: For a living creature of 8th level or higher: 8th to 12th, a strigoi servant; 13th or higher can be a progenitor. Increase its level by 1; AC, attacks, DCs, saves and skills by 1; Strike damage by 1. Fewer HP, for fast healing and resistance to physical damage (except silver or bright light) by its level. Becomes a shadow undead vampire, almost always unholy: greater darkvision, void healing, immunities, coffin restoration, strigoi weaknesses, levitate, shadowy claws with Grab, Drink Essence and Shadow Form. A progenitor also gains a fly Speed (instead of levitate), Create Servitor, Shadow Escape, Domain of Dusk and Dominate.
optional: Damage: only its Strikes deal 1 more; add 1 to its other offensive abilities (2 for limited ones) by hand. It loses abilities that come from being a living creature, and traits of its life other than human, humanoid and the ancestries (removed here): remove those by hand, and adjust abilities that conflict with its theme. Unholy: strigoi almost always are; remove it if not. A claw Strike it already has isn't replaced: give it agile, magical and Grab by hand.

resistances.suffix: (except silver or Strikes by a creature shedding bright light)

choices.label: Strigoi progenitor
choices.note: The fusion of a strigoi from the Netherworld and a living host of 13th level or higher: a fly Speed instead of levitate, Create Servitor, Shadow Escape, Domain of Dusk and Dominate; its Drink Essence drains 2.

choices.label: Write out the abilities' rules text
choices.note: Off: names and numbers only, as Paizo prints strigoi (the rules are with the Strigoi family in To Blot Out the Sun). On: Coffin Restoration, the weaknesses and each strigoi ability with its full text.

abilities.name: Coffin Restoration
abilities.description: As with moroi vampires, {name} isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, it falls unconscious and loses fast healing. If its body rests in its coffin for 1 hour, {name} gains 1 HP, after which its fast healing begins to function normally.

abilities.name: Strigoi Weaknesses
abilities.description:
All strigoi possess the following weaknesses:
**Revulsion** Strigoi are uncomfortable near mirrors or sources of bright light. Only {name}'s shadow reflects in a mirror, and this often compels it to cover or destroy mirrors in its presence rather than risk its true nature being displayed. {Name} can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of a brandished mirror or source of bright light. To brandish a mirror or light source, a creature must Interact to do so for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If {name} involuntarily comes within 10 feet of a brandished mirror or light source, it gains the fleeing condition, running from the brandished object until it ends an action beyond 10 feet. After 1 round of being exposed to the subject of its revulsion, {name} can attempt a DC 25 Will save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, it overcomes its revulsions for 1d6 rounds (or 1 hour on a critical success). {Name} can move normally around mirrors or bright light sources that are not brandished, although doing so causes it discomfort that can be noticed with a successful Perception check to Sense Motive.
**Sunlight** When exposed to direct sunlight, {name} immediately becomes unconscious and falls to the ground. It appears to be dead: it doesn't breathe, its body temperature matches its surroundings, and it doesn't react to pain or other stimuli. A successful Perception check against {name}'s Reflex DC is enough to note one anomaly: the shadow cast by its "dead" body shifts and moves slightly, its edges twisting and active. Certain detection spells, senses like lifesense, and the "corpse" taking damage from vitality energy still function normally and could reveal the truth without a successful Perception check. Viewing the "corpse" in a mirror's reflection can also reveal the truth, for only the body's shadow reflects. While in sunlight and unconscious, {name} loses its resistance to physical damage. If it takes enough damage that it would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, its body quickly decomposes, and it is destroyed.
**Water Revulsion** {Name} cannot cross a significant source of running water (such as a creek, river, or waves on a seashore). A strigoi capable of flight can cross running water provided it approaches no closer than 10 feet to the liquid's surface. If forced into running water against its will, {name} becomes slowed 2 and gains the fleeing condition as long as it remains in the water. At the end of any turn in which it remains in running water, it must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or be destroyed.

abilities.name: Shadow Escape
abilities.description: Trigger {Name} is reduced to 0 HP; Effect {Name} uses Shadow Form. They can take move actions to move toward their coffin even though they're at 0 HP. While at 0 HP in this form, {name} is unaffected by further damage. Once {name} reaches their coffin, or if they haven't done so within 2 hours, they automatically return to their physical form, unconscious.

abilities.name: Create Servitor
abilities.description: If a creature dies after being reduced to 0 HP by Domain of Dusk or Drink Essence, {name} can turn this victim into a servitor by donating some of their own blood to the victim and burying the victim in earth for 3 nights. A victim that's 8th level or higher becomes a strigoi servant, while a lower-level victim instead becomes a moroi vampire. A servitor is compelled to obey its creator, but if a vampire controls too many servitors at once (as determined by the GM), or if the servitor is a higher level than the vampire that created it, strong-willed servitors can free themselves by succeeding at a Will saving throw against {name}'s Will DC.

abilities.name: Domain of Dusk
abilities.description: {=1 + level / 2}d6 void damage (DC {dc:standard} basic Fortitude save)

abilities.name: Domain of Dusk
abilities.description: Frequency once per minute; Effect With a wave of their hand, {name} calls forth vile ruination from the surrounding shadows, causing coils of darkness and shadowy bats, rats, and wolves to lash out at living targets in a 30-foot emanation. Living creatures in this area take {=1 + level / 2}d6 void damage with a DC {dc:standard} basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails this save is also dazzled by the darkness for 1 round (or blinded for 1 round and then dazzled for 1 round on a critical failure).

abilities.name: Dominate
abilities.description: DC {spelldc:high}. {Name} can cast _dominate_ at will as a divine innate spell. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to {name}'s Dominate for 24 hours. Fully destroying {name} ends the domination, but merely reducing them to 0 HP is insufficient to break the spell.

abilities.name: Drink Essence
abilities.description:
Requirements A grabbed, paralyzed, restrained, unconscious, or willing creature is within {name}'s reach; Effect {Name} sinks their fangs into the targeted creature to drink its blood and draw out its vital essence. This requires an Athletics check against the creature's Fortitude DC if the creature is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions. The creature becomes drained 1 and stupefied 1, and {name} regains HP equal to 10\% of their maximum HP ({=hp / 10} HP), gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Essence from a creature that's already drained or stupefied doesn't restore any HP, but increases either the creature's drained condition value or its stupefied condition value by 1 (whichever value is lesser is increased; if both values are equal, then {name} chooses which condition to increase the value of).
A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a successful DC 20 Medicine check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drained value by 1 after 10 minutes.
A victim's stupefied condition decreases by 1 per day after performing daily preparations. If the daily preparations are done in full sunlight, the stupefied condition is removed entirely.

abilities.name: Shadow Form
abilities.description:
{Name} reverts to pure shadow and absorbs its body and its gear into the darkness, or it shifts back to its physical form. In shadow form, {name} gains a climb Speed equal to its land Speed and can move through any gap that isn't airtight. However, it can only move along solid surfaces that aren't highly reflective, not liquid or mirrored surfaces. If the surface it's on is destroyed, {name} returns to physical form and is stunned 1. {Name} loses fast healing while in shadow form but can remain in shadow form indefinitely.
A strigoi that is exposed to sunlight while in shadow form becomes slowed 2 and must attempt a DC 16 flat check at the end of each of its turns. If it fails this flat check, it is destroyed, the shadow vanishing with a blood-curdling wail.
